title: aidp flow definition
description: A ticket workflow definition read by the flow engine (aidp-flows). Mirrors the FlowDef model: top-level keys and step keys are closed.

blocks.description: Named step lists, referenced by an action step whose `use` names the block.

entries.description: Named places a run can be started from by hand (POST /api/tickets/:key/force, target = entry name): the top-level steps before `step` are skipped (reason `forced`), except `keep`.

step.description: Top-level step the run lands on.

keep.description: Top-level steps before `step` that still run (workspace preparation).

outputs.description: Outputs assumed for skipped steps, keyed by step id, so the conditions after `step` hold.

workspace.description: project: the steps run in the main checkout of the project (no worktree); the run holds the project's unity-editor resource from its first step until git.restore gives the checkout back (also done by the daemon when the run ends).

resource.description: Daemon resource held while the pipeline step runs; one holder at a time per project, others wait (waiting_external, reason resource:<name>). Pipeline steps only.

use.description: Registry entry (action, wait), pipeline template (pipeline) or block name.

prompt.description: Question shown for a human step.

optional.description: The flow can go on without this step: the doctor may skip it when it keeps failing.
